query: I want to build something around pagination but I am not sure what yet.
expected_behavior: Asks clarifying questions about goal and constraints
Proposes success criteria
Does not start coding

query: Plan a change that moves the footer formatting from src/format.js into src/pager.js.
expected_behavior: Lists the affected files and the order of changes
Names risks and validation steps
Confirms scope before executing
Offers distinct options with trade-offs
Recommends one
States assumptions

query: Grill me on this migration plan before we start.
expected_behavior: Asks the open frontier four questions at a time (the host's question tool, or numbered text when there is none)
Gives a recommended answer per question worded so yes accepts it
Looks up facts in the repository instead of asking the user

query: Grill me on whether I should start a paid newsletter. There is no repo, this is just a business decision.
expected_behavior: Asks the open frontier four questions at a time with a recommended answer per question
Writes no files and creates no glossary or decision record
Closes with a short recap of the decisions in the conversation

query: I cannot decide how the onboarding screen should feel: one long form or three short pages? Keep asking me until we know.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the question cannot be settled by talking and stops asking about it
Proposes or builds a cheap throwaway to react to, marked as throwaway
Continues from the user's one-line reaction instead of another round of questions

query: We are reworking authentication across three services over the next few weeks. Plan it with me, we will need several sessions.
expected_behavior: Keeps a shared plan document with Destination, Decisions so far, Not yet specified, and Out of scope
Records each settled decision as one line with a link instead of restating it
Puts questions it cannot yet phrase precisely under Not yet specified instead of asking them now

query: Plan renaming the customer_id column to account_id; it is used in about 400 places across 30 packages.
expected_behavior: Sequences the work as expand, migrate in batches by blast radius, then contract
Makes the contract step blocked by every migrate batch
Keeps the build green between batches instead of one big-bang edit

query: Grill me on how to split this monolith into services, in this repo. There are about seven open decisions.
expected_behavior: Uses the host's structured question tool instead of free-text questions when it is available
Asks at most four questions in the first round, most important first, and holds the rest of the frontier back
Writes the settled decisions to the plan document before asking the next four, and repeats until nothing is left open
Puts the recommended option first, labels it (Recommended), and does not add its own Other option

query: We need to redesign the onboarding screens but I am not sure what the flow should look like.
expected_behavior: Checks the host's skill list for design and UI skills and loads the matching ones, or says none are available
Lets their findings shape the clarifying questions and the approaches
Plans to hand execution to the design skill and does not start building yet

query: Plan adding CSV export to the reports page. I am away for the next hour, so decide whatever you can without me.
expected_behavior: Turns low-risk, easily reversed choices into stated assumptions with what would prove each wrong
Does not assume a hard-to-reverse choice such as who may export which data; it stays blocking
Ends with an Open questions line that is none or counts the blocking ones, and does not start the work that depends on a blocking question
